gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-adlam-un: Blunt and tall: College gives every curve the bulk of a straight stem, with big counters. Noto Sans Adlam Unjoined, a sans with generous curve openings and little difference between cases, can go a touch larger.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-anatolia: College draws every line like a stylus held at fixed pressure, curves as sturdy as stems, with big counters. Noto Sans Anatolian Hieroglyphs moves through long text smoothly, tall x-height filling lines.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-arabic: Noto Sans Arabic gives its small letters wide openings and a pronounced x-height, under College's joints that meet without thinning or bulging. And page after page, the text stays clean and modern, never crowding itself.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-armenian: Noto Sans Armenian stands its lowercase c, s and z tall and full, with wide, inviting openings on round letters. Shrink College and its tube-like lines lose their punch.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-avestan: Noto Sans Avestan is a modern sans-serif whose curves stop short of touching, standing on a pronounced x-height. But College, like sign-shop vinyl cut to one line width, shouts up top while the text below does the talking.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-balinese: College runs at zero modulation, each curve built as bulky as a straight stem and its counters big. One grabs attention; Noto Sans Balinese, with short ascenders, keeps text comfortable.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-bamum: College has no hairlines at all, and swells nowhere. Shrink College and its uniform lines clog up, whereas Noto Sans Bamum keeps big open counters in every small letter.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-bassa-va: Noto Sans Bassa Vah is a sans-serif with a dominant midsection. Its open-jawed c bites like pliers, so a modest size is plenty, while College holds the front with a steady, marker-like line.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-batak: College draws its letters like fine rope, curves and stems alike, with counters that stay big. Noto Sans Batak has a towering x-height and open e, so paragraphs flow.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-bengali: Noto Sans Bengali keeps capitals barely taller than lowercase and gives its letters distinctly open mouths. Noto Sans Bengali stays quiet beneath College, whose w is drawn without stroke contrast.
